name: potsherd
description: Slopie: every coding-agent session kept as plain-text records your agent can search with rg, sed or the slopie CLI, plus the terminal audit. Teaches the agent the record format and points it back to its own record after compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Plain-text memory of your coding-agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Slopie keeps every Claude Code, Codex and pi session on this machine as a plain-text record (~/.slopie/records) with an INDEX.tsv, and teaches Codex the format so it can find and continue earlier work with its own shell tools or the slopie CLI. Local only: no models, no daemon, no network.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about the connection pooler last month?
Find the session where I set up the release workflow
Summarise what I was doing in this repo before I stopped
